ideas.pitch: A verifiable credential and contribution tracking dashboard for OpenBuild Week participants to showcase their shipped prototypes, git commits, and community engagement.
ideas.title: OpenBuild Campus Leaderboard & Credential Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the core thesis of HackUnion and OpenBuild Week by serving as the ultimate capstone repository for campus communities transitioning from learning to building.

ideas.pitch: A localized logistics and peer-to-peer ride-sharing platform specifically tailored for students traveling across Hyderabad to attend Builders Day.
ideas.title: HydraBus: Campus Community Transit & Carpool Coordinator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, real-world logistical pain point for attendees gathered in-person in Hyderabad, making it highly relatable and immediately testable by the judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered generator that instantly transforms raw GitHub READMEs and rough prototype notes into polished, investor-ready presentation outlines for Builders Day demos.
ideas.title: HackUnion Pitch Deck Synthesizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Every single team at a 10-hour hackathon struggles with slide preparation; providing a utility tool that accelerates the final demo pitch appeals directly to judges evaluating execution efficiency.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized peer-evaluation and feedback kiosk allowing Builders Day teams to anonymously score and review adjacent prototypes in real time.
ideas.title: OpenBuild Peer Review Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Facilitates transparent intra-event collaboration and gamifies the final hours of the hackathon, creating high engagement among exhausted participants and organizers alike.

ideas.pitch: A micro-task and micro-bounty marketplace connecting local Hyderabad student developers with quick engineering gigs spawned from OpenBuild Week discussions.
ideas.title: Hydabad Hackers Local Bounty Board
ideas.why_it_could_win: Captures the open-source and collaborative spirit of the HackUnion community by bridging the gap between campus learners and practical local project execution.
